title: $WORK/config/iso-ids/disk-info now contains amd64v3
diff:
diff --git a/debian/changelog b/debian/changelog
index 35cd4d5..8b07518 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,10 @@
+livecd-rootfs (26.10.17) stonking; urgency=medium
+
+  * ubuntu: use ARCH_VARIANT for the ISO's .disk/info and volume ID
+    (LP: #2169089).
+
+ -- Amr Elsheshtawy <amr.elsheshtawy@canonical.com>  Thu, 01 Oct 2026 03:17:59 +0300
+
 livecd-rootfs (26.10.16) stonking; urgency=medium
 
   * ubuntu-cpc: bump arm64 generic non-cloud image to 4.5G.
diff --git a/live-build/auto/config b/live-build/auto/config
index ca33ead..f7d0bb2 100755
--- a/live-build/auto/config
+++ b/live-build/auto/config
@@ -1750,7 +1750,7 @@ fi
 if [ "${MAKE_ISO}" = "yes" ]; then
 	${LIVECD_ROOTFS_ROOT}/live-build/gen-iso-ids \
 		--project $PROJECT ${SUBPROJECT:+--subproject $SUBPROJECT} \
-		--arch $ARCH ${SUBARCH:+--subarch $SUBARCH} ${NOW+--serial $NOW} \
+		--arch ${ARCH_VARIANT:-$ARCH} ${SUBARCH:+--subarch $SUBARCH} ${NOW+--serial $NOW} \
 		${BUILD_TYPE:+--build-type $BUILD_TYPE} \
 		--output-dir config/iso-ids/
 fi
